stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "Each of the applicants ___ required to submit a photocopy of a valid ID."
explanation: "Each" is singular, so it takes the singular verb "is". The plural noun "applicants" sits inside the prepositional phrase and does not control the verb.

stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: "Thank you for your __prompt__ reply to our letter."
explanation: "Prompt" means done without delay, so quick. A prompt reply may also be polite, but that is not what the word means.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

Many towns once sent all their garbage to open dumpsites. The dumps smelled, drew rats and leaked dirty water into nearby streams. Today a growing number of barangays sort waste at the source. Kitchen scraps go to compost pits, bottles and cans are sold to junk shops, and only what cannot be used again goes to a sanitary landfill. As a result, trucks make fewer trips and the landfill fills more slowly.

What is the passage mainly about?
options: How sorting waste reduces what reaches landfills
Why towns should build more landfills
How junk shops set prices for bottles
Why rats are attracted to open dumpsites
explanation: Every sentence after the first leads to one point: sorting at the source means less waste reaches the landfill. Rats and junk shops are details, and the passage never argues for more landfills.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "Mathematics ___ my favorite subject in high school."
explanation: "Mathematics" ends in -s but names one subject, so it takes a singular verb. The past time "in high school" needs "was".

stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: "The agency was __lauded__ for its quick response to the flood."
explanation: To laud is to praise. "Blamed" is close to its opposite.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

The municipal library extended its hours to 8:00 p.m. on weekdays last June. In the months that followed, the number of borrowers rose sharply, and most of the new borrowers signed in after 5:00 p.m. Many of them listed their occupation as office worker or student.

What can be inferred from the passage?
options: The library hired new staff in June
Students prefer reading at home at night
The library will soon close on weekends
Many borrowers could not visit during office hours
explanation: New borrowers came mostly after 5:00 p.m. and were workers or students, which suggests the old hours did not suit them. Nothing is said about weekends or hiring.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "By the time the director arrived, the staff ___ the hall."
explanation: The cleaning was finished before another past action (the director arrived), so the past perfect "had cleaned" is correct.

stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: "The hall has __ample__ space for all the applicants."
explanation: Ample means more than enough, so plenty of. The sentence says there is room for every applicant.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

Before you sign a contract, read every page, not just the first and the last. Ask about any term you do not understand, and never sign a page with blank spaces that someone else could fill in later. Keep a copy of everything you sign.

What is the author's main purpose?
options: To advise readers on signing contracts safely
To describe the history of written contracts
To explain how contracts are written by lawyers
To warn readers never to sign any contract
explanation: The passage gives step-by-step advice for signing safely. It does not forbid signing, and it says nothing about how lawyers draft contracts or their history.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "The supervisor gave the new forms to Ana and ___."
explanation: "To Ana and me": the pronoun is the object of the preposition "to", so the object form "me" is needed. Drop "Ana and" to check: "gave the forms to me".

stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: "The treasurer is __scrupulous__ in handling public funds."
explanation: Scrupulous means very careful to do what is right and correct, so careful and honest. That is the quality wanted in someone who handles public money.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

The province's coffee farmers once sold their beans fresh, at low prices, to traders who visited after harvest. Three years ago a cooperative bought a shared drying and roasting machine. Members now sell roasted coffee in sealed bags to cafes in the city, and their income per kilo has more than doubled.

According to the passage, what allowed the farmers to sell to city cafes?
options: A shared drying and roasting machine
A larger coffee harvest each year
A new road built to the city
explanation: The passage links the change to the cooperative's shared machine, which let members sell roasted, bagged coffee. Roads and harvest size are not mentioned.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "___ do you think will be named the employee of the month?"
explanation: The pronoun is the subject of "will be named" ("you think he will be named"), so the subject form "Who" is correct. "Do you think" is only an inserted clause.

stem: Choose the word most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to: "optional"
explanation: Optional means left to your own choice; its opposite is required, meaning it must be done.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

The new online appointment system was supposed to end the long lines. Instead, the website crashes every morning at eight, the confirmation emails arrive a day late, and applicants still line up outside the gate before dawn. One more improvement like this, and the office may need a second gate.

What is the writer's tone?
explanation: The last sentence calls the failure an "improvement" and jokes about needing a second gate, which is sarcasm. The listed problems rule out an admiring or hopeful tone.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "The new policy will take effect ___ January 2."
explanation: Use "on" with a specific date or day, "in" with months and years, and "at" with clock times.

stem: Choose the word most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to: "reluctant"
explanation: Reluctant means unwilling or hesitant, so its opposite is eager. "Unwilling" is a synonym.

stem:
Arrange the sentences to form a logical paragraph.

1. Finally, the approved request is forwarded to the cashier for payment.
2. First, the employee fills out a reimbursement form.
3. The supervisor then checks the receipts and signs the form.
4. Next, the employee attaches the official receipts to it.
explanation: The signal words give the order: "First" (2), "Next" (4), "then" (3) and "Finally" (1). The supervisor must check the receipts after they are attached.

stem: Choose the words that best complete the sentence: "If I ___ the deadline earlier, I would have filed my application on time."
explanation: A past unreal condition uses "if" + past perfect ("had known") with "would have" + past participle in the main clause.

stem: Choose the word most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to: "brisk"
explanation: Brisk means quick and full of energy, as in a brisk walk. Its opposite is slow; "lively" is close in meaning to brisk.

stem:
Arrange the sentences to form a logical paragraph.

1. These warm waters give storms the energy they need to grow.
2. The Philippines lies beside the Pacific Ocean, where the sea is warm for much of the year.
3. This is why the country is hit by many typhoons every year.
4. Storms that form over the Pacific often move west toward the islands.
explanation: Sentence 2 introduces the setting, 1 explains what "these warm waters" do, 4 says where the storms go, and 3 draws the conclusion with "This is why".

stem: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Lesser people attended this year's seminar.
Fewer people attended this year's seminar.
Few people has attended this year's seminar.
Less people attended this year's seminar.
explanation: "Fewer" is used with things you can count (people); "less" is for amounts that cannot be counted, such as water or time.

stem: What does the underlined word mean? "The two offices agreed to __consolidate__ their records into one database."
explanation: To consolidate is to bring separate parts together into one. The phrase "into one database" signals combining.

stem:
Which sentence best completes the paragraph?

"Regular exercise helps the body in many ways. It strengthens the heart and lungs and helps control weight. ___"
options: However, many people have no time to cook.
It can also lift mood and improve sleep.
The first marathon was run in Greece.
Some gyms charge a monthly membership.
explanation: The paragraph lists benefits of exercise, so the best closing sentence adds more benefits. The others change the topic.

stem: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: She likes to read, writing and cooking.
She likes reading, writing and cooking.
She likes reading, to write and cook.
She likes reading, writing and to cook.
explanation: Items in a series should have the same form. "Reading, writing and cooking" are all -ing forms; the others mix -ing forms with infinitives.

stem: What does the underlined word mean? "Please accept our __sincere__ apology for the delay in releasing your permit."
explanation: Sincere means honest and meant from the heart, so a sincere apology is a genuine one.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

The town council debated the proposal for three hours. Several members worried about the cost, and one asked for a study of the traffic it would cause. In the end the council decided to __defer__ the vote until the study was complete.

As used in the passage, "defer" most nearly means:
explanation: The council waits "until the study was complete", so the vote is put off, not cancelled.

stem: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Walking to the office, the building looked old.
Walking to the office, I saw the old building.
While walking to the office, the building was old.
Walking to the office, the old building was seen.
explanation: The opening phrase must describe the subject that follows it. Only "I" can be walking; in the other sentences the building seems to be walking, which is a dangling modifier.

stem: What does the underlined idiom mean? "The manager told us to __keep our ears to the ground__ about the reorganization."
explanation: To keep your ear to the ground is to stay alert to news and rumors about what is happening.

stem:
Read the passage, then answer the question.

A study of public offices found that those using a numbered queue ticket served clients in an average of 12 minutes. Offices without a ticket system averaged 31 minutes, and staff there reported more arguments over who was next in line.

Which conclusion is best supported by the passage?
options: Offices without tickets have fewer clients
Queue tickets make staff work longer hours
Queue tickets are linked to faster, calmer service
Clients prefer offices that open early
explanation: Ticket offices were faster and had fewer arguments, so the passage supports a link between tickets and faster, calmer service. Nothing is said about hours, client numbers or opening times.

stem: CHEF : KITCHEN :: JUDGE : ?
explanation: A chef works in a kitchen; a judge works in a courtroom. A lawyer, a verdict and a gavel are all linked to judges, but none is a workplace.

stem: BROOM : SWEEP :: SAW : ?
explanation: A broom is used to sweep; a saw is used to cut. Wood is what a saw cuts, and a carpenter is the person who uses it.

stem: CUB : LION :: FAWN : ?
explanation: A cub is a young lion; a fawn is a young deer. A young horse is a foal and a young goat is a kid.

stem: BLIND : SIGHT :: DEAF : ?
explanation: A blind person lacks sight; a deaf person lacks hearing. Sound is what is heard and the ear is the organ, but the pair is a condition and the sense it takes away.

stem: GOVERNOR : PROVINCE :: MAYOR : ?
explanation: A governor heads a province; a mayor heads a city or municipality. A barangay is headed by a punong barangay.

stem: ODOMETER : DISTANCE :: SPEEDOMETER : ?
explanation: An odometer measures the distance a vehicle has traveled; a speedometer measures its speed. Fuel is shown by a fuel gauge, and distance belongs to the odometer.

stem: POTTER : CLAY :: CARPENTER : ?
explanation: A potter shapes clay; a carpenter works with wood. The pair is worker to the material, so a tool (hammer), a product (chair) or a workplace does not fit.

stem:
Statements: All inspectors are employees. All employees wear IDs.

Conclusions:
I. All inspectors wear IDs.
II. Everyone who wears an ID is an inspector.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: Inspectors are inside the group of employees, and all employees wear IDs, so I follows. II reverses the statement: other employees also wear IDs, so it does not follow.

stem:
Statements: Some files are red. All red things in the office are labeled.

Conclusions:
I. Some files are labeled.
II. All files are labeled.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: The red files are labeled, so at least some files are labeled (I). Nothing is said about files that are not red, so II does not follow.

stem:
Statements: No cashier is a guard. Some guards are drivers.

Conclusions:
I. No driver is a cashier.
II. Some drivers are not cashiers.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: The drivers who are guards cannot be cashiers, so some drivers are not cashiers (II). Other drivers who are not guards could still be cashiers, so I does not follow.

stem:
Statements: All mangoes are fruits. Some fruits are sour.

Conclusions:
I. Some mangoes are sour.
II. Some fruits are mangoes.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: The sour fruits may all be other kinds of fruit, so I does not follow. Every mango is a fruit, so at least some fruits are mangoes (II).

stem:
Statement: The city will fine anyone caught throwing garbage on the street.

Conclusions:
I. No one will ever throw garbage on the street again.
II. The city wants to keep its streets clean.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: A fine for littering shows the city's aim of clean streets (II). A fine discourages littering but cannot guarantee that no one will ever do it, so I does not follow.

stem:
Statement: Of the 40 employees in the division, 25 attended the training, and all of those who attended passed the test.

Conclusions:
I. At least 25 employees in the division passed the test.
II. Some employees in the division did not attend the training.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: All 25 attendees passed, so at least 25 passed (I). Only 25 of 40 attended, so 15 did not (II). Both follow.

stem:
Statement: Every applicant who passed the written test was interviewed. Maria, an applicant, was not interviewed.

Conclusions:
I. Maria failed her interview.
II. Maria did not pass the written test.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: If Maria had passed, she would have been interviewed; she was not, so she did not pass (II). She had no interview, so she cannot have failed one (I).

stem:
Statement: In the town center, traffic is heavy only on weekdays.

Conclusions:
I. Traffic in the town center is not heavy on Sundays.
II. Traffic in the town center is heavy every day of the week.

Which conclusion follows?
explanation: "Only on weekdays" means it is not heavy on weekends, which includes Sundays (I). II contradicts the statement.

stem:
The table shows the business permit applications a municipal office received and approved in four months.

| Month | Applications received | Applications approved |
|---|---|---|
| January | 240 | 180 |
| February | 300 | 210 |
| March | 360 | 288 |
| April | 200 | 170 |

How many applications did the office receive in the four months altogether?
explanation: 240 + 300 + 360 + 200 = 1,100. 848 is the total approved, not received.

stem:
The table shows the business permit applications a municipal office received and approved in four months.

| Month | Applications received | Applications approved |
|---|---|---|
| January | 240 | 180 |
| February | 300 | 210 |
| March | 360 | 288 |
| April | 200 | 170 |

In which month was the share of applications approved the highest?
explanation: Approval rates: January 180/240 = 75%, February 210/300 = 70%, March 288/360 = 80%, April 170/200 = 85%. March approved the most applications, but April approved the largest share.

stem:
The table shows the business permit applications a municipal office received and approved in four months.

| Month | Applications received | Applications approved |
|---|---|---|
| January | 240 | 180 |
| February | 300 | 210 |
| March | 360 | 288 |
| April | 200 | 170 |

By what percent did the number of applications received increase from January to March?
explanation: The increase is 360 - 240 = 120, and 120 / 240 = 50%. 150% is March as a percent of January, not the increase, and 120% reads the increase of 120 as a percent.

stem:
The table shows the business permit applications a municipal office received and approved in four months.

| Month | Applications received | Applications approved |
|---|---|---|
| January | 240 | 180 |
| February | 300 | 210 |
| March | 360 | 288 |
| April | 200 | 170 |

What was the average number of applications approved per month?
explanation: Total approved = 180 + 210 + 288 + 170 = 848, and 848 / 4 = 212. 275 is the average received (1,100 / 4), and 288 is the highest single month.

| Food | ₱12,000 |
| Rent | ₱7,500 |
| Transportation | ₱3,000 |

What percent of the family's monthly income goes to food?

The table shows how the Santos family divides its monthly income. The five items make up the whole income.

| Item | Amount per month |
|---|---|
| Food | ₱12,000 |
| Rent | ₱7,500 |
| Transportation | ₱3,000 |

What is the ratio of rent to utilities?
explanation: Rent : utilities = 7,500 : 4,500. Divide both by 1,500 to get 5 : 3.

stem:
The table shows how the Santos family divides its monthly income. The five items make up the whole income.

| Item | Amount per month |
|---|---|
| Food | ₱12,000 |
| Rent | ₱7,500 |
| Transportation | ₱3,000 |
| Utilities | ₱4,500 |
| Savings | ₱3,000 |

If the family's food spending rises by 10% and the other amounts stay the same, what will the family's total monthly spending and savings be?
explanation: Food rises by 10% of 12,000 = ₱1,200, so the total goes from ₱30,000 to ₱31,200. ₱33,000 would be a 10% rise in the whole budget, and ₱43,200 adds the new food amount (₱13,200) to the old total.

stem: Ana is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Carlo. Dina is shorter than Carlo. Who is the tallest?
explanation: From tallest to shortest the order is Ana, Ben, Carlo, Dina.

stem: What letter comes next in the series? A, D, I, P, ?
explanation: The letters stand at positions 1, 4, 9 and 16 of the alphabet, the square numbers. The next square is 25, which is Y.

stem: In a certain code, HAND is written as IBOE. How is FOOT written in the same code?
explanation: Each letter moves one place forward: H to I, A to B, N to O, D to E. So F, O, O, T become G, P, P, U. ENNS moves each letter back instead.

stem: A store sells a rice cooker for ₱2,400 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
explanation: The sale price is 80% of the original, so the original is 2,400 ÷ 0.8 = ₱3,000. Adding 20% of ₱2,400 (₱2,880) uses the wrong base.

stem: What is 5/6 + 3/8?
explanation: Use the common denominator 24: 20/24 + 9/24 = 29/24 = 1 5/24. Adding tops and bottoms (8/14) is a common mistake.

stem: Pedro can paint a room alone in 12 hours, and Jun can paint it alone in 24 hours. How long will it take them working together?
explanation: Together they paint 1/12 + 1/24 = 2/24 + 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8 of the room per hour, so they need 8 hours. Together they must be faster than Pedro alone (12 hours); 18 hours is the average and 36 hours the sum of the two times.

stem: What is 0.35 x 0.2?
explanation: 35 x 2 = 70, and the factors have 2 + 1 = 3 decimal places, so the product is 0.070 = 0.07. 0.55 is the sum, not the product.

stem: A bus travels 180 km to a town at 60 km/h and returns along the same road at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the round trip?
explanation: Time out = 180 ÷ 60 = 3 h, time back = 180 ÷ 90 = 2 h. Average speed = 360 km ÷ 5 h = 72 km/h, not the simple mean of 75.

stem: What is 48 ÷ 6 + 4 x 3 - 5?
explanation: Divide and multiply first: 48 ÷ 6 = 8 and 4 x 3 = 12. Then 8 + 12 - 5 = 15. Working strictly left to right gives the wrong answer 31; forgetting the - 5 gives 20, and adding it gives 25.

stem: Liza is now 4 times as old as her son. In 20 years she will be twice as old as he will be. How old is Liza now?
explanation: Let the son be s, so Liza is 4s. Then 4s + 20 = 2(s + 20), so 4s + 20 = 2s + 40 and s = 10. Liza is 40; 10 is the son's age now and 30 his age in 20 years.

stem: What is 15% of 360?
How much simple interest does ₱50,000 earn at 6% per year for 3 years?
explanation: Simple interest = 50,000 x 0.06 x 3 = ₱9,000. About ₱9,550 would be compound interest, and ₱3,000 is only one year.

stem: What number comes next? 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, ?
explanation: Each term is double the previous one plus 1: 79 x 2 + 1 = 159. Adding 40 (as from 39 to 79) gives the wrong answer 119.

stem: How many liters of water must be added to 12 liters of a 25% alcohol solution to make a 20% solution?
explanation: The solution has 0.25 x 12 = 3 L of alcohol. For 3 L to be 20% the total must be 3 ÷ 0.2 = 15 L, so add 15 - 12 = 3 L of water. 15 L is the new total, not the water added.

stem: What number comes next? 5, 11, 19, 29, 41, ?
explanation: The differences are 6, 8, 10, 12, so the next difference is 14: 41 + 14 = 55.

stem: Three partners share a profit of ₱84,000 in the ratio 2 : 3 : 7. How much is the largest share?
explanation: There are 2 + 3 + 7 = 12 parts, so one part is 84,000 ÷ 12 = ₱7,000. The largest share is 7 x 7,000 = ₱49,000.

stem: What number comes next? 256, 64, 16, 4, ?
explanation: Each term is one fourth of the one before: 4 ÷ 4 = 1.

stem: An office's monthly electric bill rose from ₱8,000 to ₱9,000. By what percent did it increase?
explanation: The increase is ₱1,000, and 1,000 ÷ 8,000 = 12.5%. Dividing by the new bill (9,000) gives about 11.1%, which uses the wrong base.

stem: What number comes next? 5, 10, 8, 16, 14, ?
explanation: The pattern alternates: multiply by 2, then subtract 2. After 14 comes 14 x 2 = 28.

stem: The sum of three consecutive odd numbers is 93. What is the largest of them?
explanation: The middle number is 93 ÷ 3 = 31, so the numbers are 29, 31 and 33. The largest is 33.

stem: What is the square root of 1,296?
explanation: 36 x 36 = 1,296. The last digit 6 points to a root ending in 4 or 6, and 35 x 35 = 1,225 is too small.

stem: A typist types 45 words per minute. How long will it take to type a 2,700-word report?
explanation: 2,700 ÷ 45 = 60 minutes, or one hour.

stem: What is the least common multiple of 12, 20 and 45?
explanation: 12 = 2^2 x 3, 20 = 2^2 x 5, 45 = 3^2 x 5. Take the highest powers: 4 x 9 x 5 = 180.

stem: A rectangular lot measures 25 m by 18 m. Fencing costs ₱350 per meter. How much will it cost to fence the whole lot?
explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (25 + 18) = 86 m, and 86 x 350 = ₱30,100. ₱157,500 uses the area (450 m²) instead of the perimeter.

stem: What is 2.5% written as a decimal?
explanation: Divide by 100 by moving the decimal point two places left: 2.5% = 0.025.

stem: The average of seven numbers is 25. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining six is 23. What number was removed?
explanation: The seven numbers total 7 x 25 = 175 and the six total 6 x 23 = 138. The removed number is 175 - 138 = 37. 2 is only the difference of the averages.
Subtracting a negative is adding: -8 + 15 + 6 = 13. Forgetting the double negative gives 1.

stem: A price is reduced by 10%, and the new price is then reduced by 20%. What single discount is this equal to?
explanation: After both cuts the price is 0.9 x 0.8 = 0.72 of the original, a total discount of 28% (72% is the price that is left). Adding 10% and 20% (30%) ignores that the second cut is on a smaller price.

stem: Under the 1987 Constitution, appointments in the civil service are made according to merit and fitness, determined as far as practicable by:
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(2): appointments are made according to merit and fitness determined, as far as practicable, by competitive examination, except for policy-determining, primarily confidential or highly technical positions.

stem: Within how many working days from receipt must public officials and employees respond to letters and requests from the public under R.A. 6713?
explanation: Section 5(a) of R.A. 6713 requires a response within 15 working days from receipt, stating the action taken. 45 working days is the deadline for heads of office to submit annual performance reports.

stem: According to the Constitution, the civil service covers all branches, agencies and instrumentalities of the government, including government-owned or controlled corporations:
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(1) covers GOCCs "with original charters", that is, those created by a special law. Corporations set up under the general corporation law are outside the civil service.

stem: Under R.A. 6713, the Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) must be filed every year on or before:
explanation: Section 8 requires the SALN within 30 days after assuming office, on or before April 30 of every year, and within 30 days after leaving the service.

stem: Which activity does the Constitution expressly prohibit for officers and employees in the civil service?
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(4) bars civil servants from engaging, directly or indirectly, in any electioneering or partisan political campaign. Section 2(5) protects their right to self-organization, so joining an organization is allowed.

stem: Which norm of conduct in R.A. 6713 requires public servants to serve everyone without unfair discrimination, regardless of party affiliation?
explanation: Section 4(d), political neutrality, requires service to everyone without unfair discrimination regardless of party affiliation or preference.

stem: Which article of the 1987 Constitution begins with "Public office is a public trust"?
options: Article II, Declaration of Principles and State Policies
Article XI, Accountability of Public Officers
explanation: Article XI, Section 1 opens: "Public office is a public trust. Public officers and employees must, at all times, be accountable to the people..."

stem: Under R.A. 6713, the prohibited acts in Section 7 continue to apply for how long after an official resigns, retires or leaves public office?
explanation: Section 7 says its prohibitions continue to apply for one year after resignation, retirement or separation from public office.

stem: How many senators make up the Senate under the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Article VI, Section 2: the Senate is composed of 24 senators elected at large by the qualified voters of the Philippines. Half are elected every three years.

stem: Under R.A. 6713, "relatives" are persons related to the official within which degree of consanguinity or affinity?
explanation: Section 3(k) defines relatives as persons within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity, including bilas, inso and balae.

stem: For how long may the President proclaim martial law or suspend the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus before Congress must extend it?
explanation: Article VII, Section 18 limits the proclamation or suspension to a period not exceeding 60 days unless Congress extends it. The President must report to Congress within 48 hours.

stem: Which body does the 1987 Constitution create to investigate violations of civil and political rights?
explanation: Article XIII, Section 17 creates the independent Commission on Human Rights, which investigates all forms of human rights violations involving civil and political rights.

stem: Which body has the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment?
explanation: Article XI, Section 3: the House of Representatives has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment; the Senate has the sole power to try and decide the case.

stem: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in what year?
explanation: The UDHR was adopted on December 10, 1948, which is why Human Rights Day is marked on December 10. The UN itself was founded in 1945, and the two international covenants date from 1966.

stem: How many justices make up the Supreme Court, including the Chief Justice?
explanation: Article VIII, Section 4(1): the Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices, 15 in all.

stem: Which law created the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM)?
explanation: R.A. 11054 of 2018, the Bangsamoro Organic Law, created BARMM after a plebiscite in 2019, replacing the ARMM that R.A. 6734 had set up in 1989.

stem: The 1987 Constitution declares that civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over:
explanation: Article II, Section 3: "Civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over the military."

stem: Which law requires waste to be segregated at the source and bans open dumpsites?
explanation: R.A. 9003 of 2000, the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act, requires segregation at source, materials recovery facilities and the closure of open dumpsites.

stem: Under Article XVII, a petition for amendment by people's initiative must be signed by at least what share of all registered voters?
explanation: Article XVII, Section 2 requires at least 12% of the total registered voters, with every legislative district represented by at least 3% of its registered voters.

stem: Which judicial writ may be filed to protect the constitutional right to a balanced and healthful ecology when the damage affects two or more cities or provinces?
explanation: The writ of kalikasan, under the Supreme Court's 2010 Rules of Procedure for Environmental Cases, covers environmental damage of such magnitude that it harms life, health or property in two or more cities or provinces.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "The list of requirements ___ posted on the bulletin board."
explanation: The subject is "list", which is singular, so the verb is "is". "Of requirements" only describes the list.

stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: "The town honored an __eminent__ doctor at the ceremony."

Mangroves grow best in deep, clear water
Crabs are the most common animal at sea
Mangroves protect coasts and shelter young sea life

stem: File names by surname, then first name, letter by letter. In which pair is the first name correctly filed before the second?

stem: A clerk files 48 folders an hour. How many folders can she file in 6.5 hours?

explanation: 12 x 200 = 2,400, leaving 456; 12 x 38 = 456. So the answer is 238.

stem: Of 120 employees in an office, 45 are men. What percent are women?

explanation: 450 ÷ 5 = 90, and 2 x 90 = 180. 270 is three fifths, the part left over.

explanation: 35 minutes is 35/60 = 7/12 of an hour, so speed = 21 ÷ 7/12 = 21 x 12 ÷ 7 = 36 km/h. 42 km/h would be the speed for 30 minutes.

stem: What is 1/2 + 1/3?
explanation: Use sixths: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6. Adding the tops and the bottoms gives the wrong answer 2/5.

explanation: Line up the decimal points: 4.75 + 2.60 = 7.35. 5.01 comes from adding 2.6 as if it were 0.26.

stem: The ratio of men to women among 56 employees is 3 : 4. How many women are there?
explanation: There are 3 + 4 = 7 parts, so one part is 56 ÷ 7 = 8 employees. Women = 4 x 8 = 32; men are 24. 28 is simply half the staff.

stem: What is 20% of 115?
explanation: 20% is one fifth, and 115 ÷ 5 = 23. 92 is the remaining 80%.

stem: A vendor buys an item for ₱800 and sells it for ₱1,000. What is her profit as a percent of the cost?
explanation: Profit = ₱200, and 200 ÷ 800 = 25%. 20% would be the profit as a share of the selling price.

stem: What number comes next? 7, 13, 19, 25, ?
explanation: Each term is 6 more than the one before: 25 + 6 = 31.

stem: A water tank holds 1,500 liters and is 2/5 full. How many more liters are needed to fill it?
explanation: It holds 2/5 x 1,500 = 600 L now, so 1,500 - 600 = 900 L more are needed.

stem: What number comes next? 1, 8, 27, 64, ?
explanation: These are the cubes 1 x 1 x 1, 2 x 2 x 2, 3 x 3 x 3 and 4 x 4 x 4, so the next is 5 x 5 x 5 = 125.

stem: Three boxes weigh 12.5 kg, 8.75 kg and 10.25 kg. What is their total weight?
What number comes next? 4, 20, 100, 500, ?
explanation: Each term is five times the one before: 500 x 5 = 2,500. Adding 20 (520) or doubling (1,000) misses the pattern.

stem: If 5 kg of mangoes cost ₱450, how much do 8 kg cost?
explanation: One kilo costs 450 ÷ 5 = ₱90, so 8 kg cost 8 x 90 = ₱720.

stem: What number comes next? 120, 116, 108, 96, 80, ?
explanation: The amounts taken away grow by 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, then 20. So 80 - 20 = 60.

stem: A worker is paid ₱80 an hour and 1.25 times that rate for overtime. How much does he earn for 8 regular hours and 2 overtime hours?
explanation: Regular pay = 8 x 80 = ₱640. The overtime rate is 80 x 1.25 = ₱100, so 2 hours earn ₱200. Total ₱840. ₱640 leaves out the overtime.

stem: According to Article II of the 1987 Constitution, sovereignty resides in:
explanation: Article II, Section 1: "Sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them."

stem: R.A. 6713 is known as the:
options: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards
Government Auditing Code of the Philippines
explanation: R.A. 6713 of 1989 is the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees. The Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act is R.A. 3019 and the Local Government Code is R.A. 7160. The Government Auditing Code is a 1978 decree, not a republic act.

stem: In which article of the 1987 Constitution is the Bill of Rights found?
explanation: Article III is the Bill of Rights. Article II states principles and policies, Article IV covers citizenship and Article XIII social justice and human rights.

stem: Which norm of conduct in R.A. 6713 says public servants should lead modest lives and avoid extravagant display of wealth?
explanation: Section 4(h), simple living, requires modest lives appropriate to one's position and income, with no extravagant or ostentatious display of wealth.

stem: What is the term of office of the President under the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Article VII, Section 4: the President is elected for a term of six years and is not eligible for any reelection.

stem: Which norm of conduct in R.A. 6713 includes promoting the use of locally produced goods, resources and technology?
explanation: Section 4(f), nationalism and patriotism, calls for loyalty to the Republic and the Filipino people and promoting locally produced goods, resources and technology.

stem: What is the minimum age to vote under Article V of the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Article V, Section 1 gives suffrage to citizens at least 18 years old who meet the residence requirements.

stem: Under R.A. 6713, which government agency has the primary responsibility for administering and enforcing the Code?
explanation: Section 12 gives the Civil Service Commission primary responsibility for administering and enforcing the Act and authority to issue its rules.

stem: Which three are the constitutional commissions under Article IX?
explanation: Article IX names three independent constitutional commissions: the Civil Service Commission, the Commission on Elections and the Commission on Audit. The Commission on Human Rights is created under Article XIII.

stem: R.A. 6713 says documents should, as far as practicable, need no more than how many signatories?
explanation: Section 5(c) requires documents to be processed within a reasonable time and, as far as practicable, to carry not more than three signatories.

stem: Under the Bill of Rights, a person under investigation for an offense has the right to:
options: refuse to give his or her name
explanation: Article III, Section 12(1) guarantees the right to be informed of the right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel, preferably of one's own choice.

stem: Human Rights Day is observed every year on:
explanation: December 10 marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948. June 12 is Independence Day and November 30 is Bonifacio Day.

stem: What is the national language of the Philippines under the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Article XIV, Section 6: "The national language of the Philippines is Filipino." Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, English are the official languages.

stem: Which law protects women and their children from physical, sexual, psychological and economic abuse by a partner?
explanation: R.A. 9262, the Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children (Anti-VAWC) Act of 2004, covers physical, sexual, psychological and economic abuse by a partner or former partner. The Safe Spaces Act covers gender-based harassment in streets, workplaces and online.

stem: Which principle does the 1987 Constitution declare "inviolable"?
explanation: Article II, Section 6: "The separation of Church and State shall be inviolable."

stem: The Philippines is a party to the United Nations convention that protects the rights of every person below 18 years of age. What is it called?
options: Convention on the Rights of the Child
explanation: The Convention on the Rights of the Child (1989) covers every person below 18. The Philippines ratified it in 1990.

stem: Under the Bill of Rights, no person shall be imprisoned for:
explanation: Article III, Section 20: "No person shall be imprisoned for debt or non-payment of a poll tax." Theft, estafa and murder are crimes punished by law.

stem: Which law sets national air quality standards and bans the incineration of municipal, medical and hazardous waste that gives off toxic fumes?
explanation: R.A. 8749, the Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999, sets air quality standards and bans incinerating municipal, biomedical and hazardous waste in a way that emits poisonous and toxic fumes. Open burning of solid waste is also banned under R.A. 9003.

stem: On what date was the 1987 Constitution ratified by the Filipino people in a plebiscite?
explanation: The plebiscite was held on February 2, 1987. The Constitutional Commission presented its draft on October 15, 1986, February 25, 1986 ended the EDSA People Power Revolution, and January 17, 1973 is when the 1973 Constitution was proclaimed ratified.

stem: Which agency is the lead government agency for environment and natural resources?
explanation: The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) manages and protects the country's environment and natural resources. DILG oversees local governments, DPWH public works and DOTr transportation.

stem: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: "The committee ___ its decision after a long meeting."

stem: What is 3 1/2 x 2/7?
explanation: Change the mixed number: 3 1/2 = 7/2. Then 7/2 x 2/7 = 14/14 = 1.

stem: A train leaves at 7:30 a.m. and travels 210 km at 70 km/h. What time does it arrive?
explanation: Travel time = 210 ÷ 70 = 3 hours, and 7:30 a.m. + 3 hours = 10:30 a.m.

stem: What number comes next? 1, 3, 4, 7, 11, 18, ?
explanation: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 11 + 18 = 29.

stem: A number increased by 40% gives 182. What is the number?
explanation: 1.4 x n = 182, so n = 182 ÷ 1.4 = 130. Subtracting 40 from 182 (142) treats the percent as a plain number.

stem: Which fraction is equal to 0.625?
explanation: 0.625 = 625/1000; divide top and bottom by 125 to get 5/8. As decimals, 3/5 = 0.6, 5/6 is about 0.833 and 7/8 = 0.875.

stem: One pipe fills a tank in 4 hours and another fills it in 12 hours. How long do both pipes take together?
explanation: Together they fill 1/4 + 1/12 = 3/12 + 1/12 = 4/12 = 1/3 of the tank per hour, so 3 hours. Two pipes must beat the faster pipe alone (4 hours); 8 hours is the average of the two times.

stem: Which officials may be removed from office through impeachment?
options: Governors and city or municipal mayors
Senators and members of the House
The President and Supreme Court justices
explanation: Article XI, Section 2 lists the President, the Vice-President, the members of the Supreme Court, the members of the constitutional commissions and the Ombudsman. Members of Congress are disciplined by their own chamber.

stem: Under R.A. 6713, an official who has a conflict of interest must divest his or her shares in a private business within how many days of assuming office?
explanation: Section 9 requires resignation from any position in the private business within 30 days and divestment of shareholdings or interest within 60 days of assuming office.

stem: The 1987 Constitution says the State shall protect and advance the right of the people to:
explanation: Article II, Section 16: "The State shall protect and advance the right of the people to a balanced and healthful ecology in accord with the rhythm and harmony of nature."

stem: Which law created the Climate Change Commission and set up the national framework for climate change action?
options: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
explanation: R.A. 9729, the Climate Change Act of 2009, created the Climate Change Commission to coordinate climate policy and plans.

stem: Under Article IX-B, a candidate who has lost in an election may not be appointed to any government office within what period after the election?
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 6: no candidate who has lost in any election shall, within one year after the election, be appointed to any office in the government or any GOCC.

stem: Which law created the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC)?
explanation: R.A. 10121, the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010, created the NDRRMC. R.A. 9729 is the Climate Change Act, R.A. 8749 the Clean Air Act and R.A. 9275 the Clean Water Act.
